gdp_accounts.units: Millions of Canadian dollars; seasonally adjusted at annual rates
gdp_accounts.transformation: Current prices for expenditure shares and annual decomposition; chained 2017 dollars for real GDP and the implicit deflator. Annual pie uses only years with all four quarters. C includes households and NPISH; I includes all fixed capital formation and inventories; G is government consumption; NX = exports minus imports. Statistical discrepancy is reported separately.

can_gdp_per_capita.units: Chained 2017 CAD per person; quarterly, seasonally adjusted at annual rates
can_gdp_per_capita.transformation: Official per-capita GDP, indexed to 2000Q1 = 100; no interpolation or extrapolation of annual population.

worldbank.units: As defined by the WDI indicator codes in the CSV header; PPP amounts at constant 2021 international dollars
worldbank.transformation: Exclude region/income aggregates using country metadata. Cross-sections use the latest common year with complete variables and at least 150 countries, or every selected country for small comparisons. No mixing indicator years. Price level = PPP conversion factor / exchange rate, normalized to the US value in the same year.

big_mac.transformation: Use the two latest published dates from the official file; USD_raw times 100, dollar_price in current USD. Dates and axis range derived from the file.

pricinglab.transformation: Raw daily domestic and imported indices, cumulative price change = (index - 1) * 100. Preserve the source baseline. The public file may lag the retrieval date.

hdi.transformation: UNDP HDI merged by country code and year with WDI real GDP per capita and population. Latest complete year with at least 150 countries; exclude aggregates.

jones_klenow.transformation: Historical replication result: Levels in 2007, welfare and GDP per capita relative to US, divided by 100. This paper does not supply a current-year cross-section. Bubble populations are WDI 2007.

core_cpi.units: CPI excluding food and energy, index 2002=100, Canada, NSA
core_cpi.transformation: 12-month percent change; no filling missing observations.

us_gdp.units: BEA real GDP (chained 2017 USD), quarterly, seasonally adjusted at annual rates; per person for A939RX0Q048SBEA
us_gdp.transformation: Indexed to 2000Q1 = 100 for the comparison plot.

us_gdp_per_capita.units: BEA real GDP (chained 2017 USD), quarterly, seasonally adjusted at annual rates; per person for A939RX0Q048SBEA
us_gdp_per_capita.transformation: Indexed to 2000Q1 = 100 for the comparison plot.

can_total_investment.units: IMF real gross capital formation, millions of CAD, quarterly, seasonally adjusted (not annualized)
can_total_investment.transformation: Archived IMF/FRED series used for the audit of the former figure. Final C/I/G and investment breakdown figures use StatCan fixed-2017-price accounts instead, on one consistent price basis.

vectors.62306867: Non-profit institutions serving households' final consumption expenditure
vectors.62306896: Gross domestic product at market prices

gdp_constant_prices.units: Millions of CAD at fixed 2017 prices, quarterly, seasonally adjusted at annual rates
gdp_constant_prices.transformation: C = households + NPISH; I = fixed capital formation + investment in inventories; G = government consumption. HP filter of levels (lambda=1600) on full sample; display 1981 onward. C/I/G deviations divided by own trend. Fixed/inventory cycle contributions divided by total investment trend, so they sum exactly to the total cycle.
